rv.q: To say Alexis J. Roston's performance as Billie Holiday in LADY DAY AT EMERSON'S BAR AND GRILL is a masterclass in acting and singing is no exaggeration.
"Lady Day" offers audiences the chance to cozy up to Roston and experience Billie Holiday in 3D on an impossibly small scale.
It all makes this 90-minute show riveting from start to finish.
Roston's show-stopping performance as Lady Day showed us why she is a superb actor and songster— wowing us with her exceptional depiction of Holiday.
“Lady Day at Emerson’s Bar and Grill” hits all the right notes.
Roston was born to play Billie Holiday! She is astonishing.
Roston’s sparkle and vulnerability create room for empathy and admiration for Holiday, who is still standing and singing despite it all.
Roston is just the person to lead us through.
For those who are fans of Billie Holiday, you'll be thrilled at how Rosten captures her voice and charm.
I do recommend that you see Lady Day at Emerson's Bar and Grill.
Commanding vocals make Alexis Roston a powerhouse as she channels the one-of-a-kind Billie Holiday.

cn.t: Roston delivers a transcendent, masterclass performance as Billie Holiday, channeling the jazz legend with commanding vocals and lived-in authenticity. Critics praise the intimate, heartbreaking portrayal in this beautifully layered production.
